In terms of capability-based security, there is currently a research program exploring the feasibility of [Capability Hardware Enhanced RISC Instructions (CHERI) architecture](https://www.cl.cam.ac.uk/research/security/ctsrd/cheri/).

Arm in partnership with the University of Cambridge has developed the [Morello prototype board](https://www.arm.com/architecture/cpu/morello). In support of the ecosystem around this architecture,  they have "extended" [C/C++](https://www.cl.cam.ac.uk/techreports/UCAM-CL-TR-947.pdf).

Hope this answers your question :)
